statewideTerm: The Governor is elected to a four-year term ending in January 2027. Maine has no lieutenant governor. The Secretary of State, Attorney General and Treasurer are elected by the Legislature for two-year terms, and the State Auditor for four years; the Legislature elected on November 3, 2026 chooses the next officers in December.

notes.election: A general election was held on November 3, 2026. This roster lists officials in office on the build date; people elected on November 3 take office in January 2027 and are not shown yet.
